adjudications.strongest_case_for_original_finding: The occurrence accepts measured/carry-forward input without a1000-ng bound and exposes a numeric selection list beside an explicit control dependency. A consumer relying on that list alone has no recommendation above1000ng, even though two source rows are available. The list is not merely an unrelated omitted reagent catalogue.
adjudications.strongest_case_against_original_finding: The action says to complete manufacturer PCR using the guide rule; it does not say that the resource string is the complete table. The verb Complete modifies the experimental operation, not table exhaustiveness. Each listed range is true, source delegation remains explicit, the source itself recommends optimizing cycles, and the declared output is a general assay description rather than a standalone executable lookup policy.
adjudications.verdict: The source establishes a partial inline extraction of a finite decision table. It does not establish that a false numeric recommendation was asserted, that the historical experiment selected wrong cycles, or that the general assay architecture is unsupported. Under the declared general-description/delegated-protocol scope, this is a conditional completeness/usability limitation; calling it a confirmed fidelity hallucination or automatically a missing core branch overstates the evidence.
adjudications.consequence: For a later design/execution using input above1000ng, the inline numbers alone are insufficient and the agent must retrieve the referenced rule or use the additional source rows. No extra Operation, physical branch or Module is needed merely to represent these rows.
when_required_record_revision_is_justifi: The extraction contract explicitly requires the full selected finite cycle-decision table.
The record or consumer advertises the inline resource list as an exhaustive/self-contained cycle-selection policy.
A generated protocol actually chooses or validates cycles for an input in the omitted range without reopening the source.
adjudications.proportionate_resolution: Prefer marking the inline ranges as partial and keeping source delegation explicit, or include the two adjacent rows when retaining a complete table is the intended representation. This is a scope/documentation choice, not discovery of new chemistry or proof that every manufacturer detail belongs in the general graph.
adjudications.counting_policy: Count as partial conditional-rule coverage at the table/detail level. Do not count the four correct rows as false assertions or infer overall assay failure from their incompleteness.

observations.exact_phrase: Combines independent reporter measurements without treating the six PHOs as separate sequential optical bits.

adjudications.strongest_case_for_original_finding: In measurement/statistical prose, independent measurements can naturally imply independent errors. The information_effect is an unqualified assertion with reported source attribution in its evidence rationales. Distinct barcodes and improved accuracy do not prove independent errors, and the source offers the random-versus-systematic explanation conditionally. An innovation agent must not turn this into an established independence primitive.
adjudications.strongest_case_against_original_finding: The sentence contrasts simultaneous reporters with sequential optical bits. In that context independent can colloquially mean separately identifiable reporter channels. The action merely combines each unique PHO vote; it introduces no error distribution, covariance, likelihood product or independence-based performance guarantee. The quoted Methods support that distinct-reporter interpretation.
adjudications.verdict: This wording is needlessly ambiguous and can reasonably be tightened to distinct or uniquely barcoded. However the phrase alone does not demonstrate that the candidate asserted statistical independence of reporter errors. The original host label selects the strongest technical reading without ruling out the source-supported colloquial reading. Treat it as an ambiguous/possibly overstrong property assertion pending that interpretation, not a confirmed invented statistical property or broken estimator.
adjudications.consequence: The stated voting operation and its material/data dependencies remain source-supported. A downstream agent may use multiple distinct reporters as the demonstrated design, but may not cite this sentence as proof that errors are independent or that noise cancellation will transfer to another context.
when_required_record_revision_is_justifi: The field is defined to assert technical statistical properties and independent is intended as statistical independence.
A downstream proposal infers an independence-based error/variance or transfer guarantee from the phrase.
The publication policy deliberately requires source-unambiguous property wording; label that action clarification, not an experimentally refuted independence claim.
adjudications.proportionate_resolution: A low-cost clarification to distinct, separately measured or uniquely barcoded reporters avoids the ambiguity while retaining the reported voting procedure. If claiming statistical independence, require separate supporting evidence and state the relevant conditioning/context. Random noise alone also does not establish independence.
adjudications.counting_policy: Do not include this automatically as one confirmed hallucination in a precision/error count. Record the ambiguous field and the unestablished statistical interpretation separately.

overall_adjudication.status: Two useful local quality findings; the original two-confirmed-required-fidelity-corrections framing is stronger than the evidence under this general-description scope.
overall_adjudication.distinction: Completeness asks whether selected source detail or decision coverage is retained. Fidelity asks whether the record says something its sources do not support. One can fail a stricter usability/completeness contract without hallucinating; ambiguous language needs an explicit interpretation before being scored as false.
overall_adjudication.no_unqualified_candidate_support_claim: This adjudication examines only these two host findings and does not certify the full initial graph, its source completeness or any native acceptance.
overall_adjudication.policy_choice: An editorial/representation gate may require both clarifications. Keep that policy separate from a claim that two demonstrated scientific errors occurred.
